title: Now Follows the Episode of Kullu

blocks.text: The Kullu narrative gives way to another turn as word and letters move toward Chamba and the next ruler is drawn into decision-making about Banda Singh.
A vazir warns that Banda is dangerous and miraculous, but gifts and approaches are still prepared, and Banda answers that he can come without an army if required.
Chamba is the anchor because this page functions mainly as a transition into the next hill-state episode rather than a self-contained battle.
